label_policy.PASS: The answer makes an explicit, unambiguous claim supported by the supplied facts.
label_policy.FAIL: The answer makes an explicit, unambiguous claim contradicted by the supplied facts.
label_policy.REVIEW: The text contains a claim but automatic binding is unsafe, unsupported, conditional, negated, or fact-conflicted.
label_policy.NOT_APPLICABLE: The answer contains no completed-state or payment claim to verify.
